0022600018.text: The New York Knicks visit the Philadelphia 76ers with a 2-3 record, fourth in the Atlantic and 2 games back, and eighth in the East, while the 76ers are 4-1, first in the Atlantic and second in the East. New York is riding a two-game winning streak, and Philadelphia has won its last game, and the teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2 before the Knicks won the 2025-26 playoff series 4-0. This season, the Knicks trail 0-1 after a 106-100 loss in New York on October 20, and Jose Alvarado (ankle sprain) is out for New York, while Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), Dominick Barlow (back fracture), Jabari Walker (knee soreness) and Tacko Fall (quadriceps strain) are all out for Philadelphia.
